keywords.description: Keywords or years used to find relevant passages anywhere in the full article.
keywords.title: Keywords

language.description: Wikipedia language: en or ru; ignored for an explicit URL.
language.title: Language

url.description: Optional public HTTP(S) source page, preferably an official source. Redirects and private addresses are refused.

expression.title: Expression

function.description: Run a restricted numeric Python subset in a separate process (2 CPU seconds, 3 wall seconds, 256 MiB memory). No imports, attributes, strings, file access or network.
